title_cn: 特朗普发出对伊朗保持克制的信号权力平衡 2026 年 8 月 10 日
summary: On the early edition of Balance of Power, Bloomberg Washington Correspondent Joe Mathieu discusses the latest from the Middle East. On today's show, Democratic Congresswoman Suzan DelBene of Washington, Stonecourt Capital Partner Rick Davis, Harvard Kennedy School Ash Center Visiting Democracy Fellow Jeanne Sheehan Zaino and Princeton University Professor Bernard Haykel. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Ready to Let Economic Pressure Build on Iran
title_cn: 特朗普准备对伊朗施加经济压力
summary: President Donald Trump says he's ready to let economic pressure build on Iran. He also says the country should pay for damages it has caused to neighbors. Bloomberg's Josh Wingrove reports from the White House. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Democrat Candidates Aren't 'Cookie Cutter,' Says DCCC Chair DelBene
title_cn: DCCC 主席德尔贝内表示，民主党候选人并非“千篇一律”
summary: Representative Suzan DelBene, who heads the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee, said Democratic candidates aren't 'cookie-cutter' and that they reflect their communities and the issues that matter to voters in their home districts. DelBene said that the path to winning back the house runs through purple districts around the country and that candidates running in those districts have 'crossover appeal.' (Source: Bloomberg)
